title: 第1502章 火晶兽皇再出现第1501章 疯狂下黑暗神晶
content_zh:
与此同时，后方的火晶兽皇也察觉到了危险。
它咆哮着想要后退，但庞大的身躯反而成了累赘。
引力拉扯下，火晶兽皇被一点点拖向幽渊。
林玄眼中闪过疯狂之色。
他咬牙催动储物戒指。
哗啦啦——
无数灵晶如洪水般倾泻而出。
一千万。
五千万。
一亿。
两亿！
整整两亿灵晶，在林玄的操控下化作一条灵石洪流，主动朝幽渊涌去。
灵石洪流没入幽渊，释放出磅礴至极的灵气。
幽渊吞噬灵气的速度明显下降。
原本急速扩散的体积开始减缓。
而此刻，骷海圣焦黑的身躯已经被幽渊彻底吞噬。
临死前，他那怨毒的目光死死盯着林玄，仿佛要将对方的身影刻入灵魂深处。
林玄面无表情。
他握着那把从骷海圣手中抢来的高等圣级战矛，眼中寒光一闪。
“该你了。”

空间之力轰然爆发。
林玄身形如电，瞬移至火晶兽皇上方。
战矛高举过顶。
九成空间本源尽数灌入矛身。
这一刻，战矛仿佛承载了整个空间的重量。
“给我——进去！”
林玄暴喝一声。
战矛携带着雷霆万钧之势，狠狠劈在火晶兽皇头部！
这一击的力量，配合火晶兽皇自身的挣扎，将其庞大的身躯猛然轰向幽渊。
火晶兽皇发出不甘的咆哮。
但终究无法抗拒幽渊的恐怖引力。
金红色的巨大身躯被一点点吸入黑洞之中。
幽渊吞噬了火晶兽皇，吞噬了数万头火晶兽，吞噬了方圆千里内的所有熔岩。
然后——
它开始缩小。
从原本急速扩张的状态，转为急剧收缩。
万丈。
千丈。
百丈。
content_en:
At the same time, the Fire Crystal Beast King behind also sensed the danger.
It roared and tried to retreat, but its huge body became a burden.
Pulled by gravity, the Fire Crystal Beast King was dragged towards the abyss little by little.
A look of madness flashed in Lin Xuan's eyes.
He gritted his teeth and urged the storage ring.
Crash--
Countless spiritual crystals poured out like a flood.
Ten million.
Fifty million.
One hundred million.
Two hundred million!
A total of 200 million spiritual crystals, under Lin Xuan's control, turned into a torrent of spiritual stones and actively rushed towards the abyss.
The torrent of spiritual stones submerged into the abyss, releasing majestic spiritual energy.
The speed at which Abyss devoured spiritual energy dropped significantly.
The volume that was originally spreading rapidly began to slow down.
At this moment, the charred body of the Skeleton Sea Saint has been completely swallowed by the abyss.
Before he died, his vicious eyes stared at Lin Xuan, as if he wanted to carve the other person's figure into the depths of his soul.
Lin Xuan's face was expressionless.
He held the high-level holy war spear that he snatched from the Skeleton Sea Saint, with a cold light flashing in his eyes.
"It's your turn."
The power of space exploded.
Lin Xuan's figure was like lightning, teleporting above the Fire Crystal Beast King.
The war spear was raised high above his head.
Ninety percent of the space origin was poured into the spear body.
At this moment, the war spear seemed to carry the weight of the entire space.
"Give me—get in!"
Lin Xuan shouted loudly.
The war spear carried the force of thunder and struck hard on the head of the Fire Crystal Beast King!
The power of this blow, combined with the Fire Crystal Beast King's own struggle, suddenly blasted its huge body into the abyss.
The Fire Crystal Beast King roared unwillingly.
But after all, he could not resist the terrifying gravity of the abyss.
The huge golden-red body was sucked into the black hole bit by bit.
Youyuan swallowed up the Fire Crystal Beast King, swallowed tens of thousands of Fire Crystal Beasts, and swallowed up all the lava within a thousand miles.
Then——
It starts to shrink.
From the original state of rapid expansion, it turned into a rapid contraction.
lofty.
Thousands of feet.
Baizhang.
